messages.author: ca0f657287afb1ff
messages.subject: multiple comparisons correction for p.perm
parts:
Hi Chris,
We can have the values of p, p.fdr and p.perm by using brainGraph_GLM for one graph/vertex attribute. Is it necessary to perform correction for multiple comparisons on the p.perm?

messages.author: 28bb28f8fe8898a5
messages.subject: Re: [brainGraph-help] multiple comparisons correction for p.perm
parts:
No, not if you calculate permutations. See
https://brainder.org/tag/multiple-testing-problem/ and references listed there
for the reasons.
